item.title: Rogers goes wide with Starlink-powered D2D service
item.description: In the wake of recent trials, Canada's Rogers Communications has launched Rogers Satellite, a direct-to-device service that is initially connected to Starlink's LEO satellite constellation, with Lynk Global on deck.

item.title: Disney invests $1B in OpenAI, inks licensing deal
item.description: Disney is investing $1 billion in OpenAI on top of a three-year licensing deal that allows OpenAI's Sora users to generate short, user-prompted and sharable videos based on more than 200 Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars characters. #pressrelease

item.title: Charter and Cox pick Comcast unit to distribute out-of-market games
item.description: Comcast Technology Solutions said it has been tapped to manage and distribute channels for out-of-market games for MLB, NHL and NBA for Charter and Cox. #pressrelease

item.title: ThinkBig rebrands as IQ Fiber
item.description: ThinkBig Networks has rebranded as IQ Fiber following acquisition in January 2025. #pressrelease

item.title: Comcast and Rogers up their game with Amazon Luna
item.description: Comcast and Canada's Rogers Communications have integrated and launched Amazon's cloud-powered Luna gaming service. Comcast will offer Luna on X1 devices, starting with the Xi6, as well as the Xumo Stream Box.

item.title: Disney invests $1B in OpenAI, cuts licensing deal
item.description: Amid copyright clashes with Midjourney, MiniMax and Google, Disney will invest $1 billion into OpenAI and sign a licensing deal that allows Sora users to create short videos featuring Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars characters.

item.title: YouTube TV on track to become the largest US Pay-TV operator by 2027 – Omdia
item.description: With nearly 3 billion global users, YouTube remains the largest video ecosystem in the world by a significant margin. #pressrelease

item.title: GenAI and AI agents drive shift to new telecom customer experience framework – Omdia
item.description: This shift means telecom operators must design experiences that work seamlessly for both people and their digital proxies, treating these AI agents as customers in their own right. #pressrelease

item.title: Ciena upbeat following strong data center, service provider demand in 2025
item.description: Ciena saw strong revenue growth this year with data center and service provider demand staying strong after a period of under-investment, and AI continuing to generate demand.

item.title: NextNav sets up alternative to GPS
item.description: NextNav will soon start to operate a 5G positioning, navigation and timing and 3D geolocation network in Santa Clara County, billing it as a complement to GPS. #pressrelease
